# PolyPop script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## polypop.isConnected

Checks whether PolyPop is connected to Cuebot right now (at least one Cuebot plugin in PolyPop).

**Gives back:** true while at least one PolyPop plugin is connected, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("polypop.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.polypop_is_connected()
    ```

## polypop.triggerAlert

Sets off a WebSocket Alert in PolyPop and hands it some words to show. Fails with an error when PolyPop is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alertName` | `alert_name` | The alert's name as set in PolyPop, like "Follow". Needed. |
| `variables` | `variables` | Optional. Words for the alert to use, like {"user": "CoolViewer"}. Every value is sent as text. |

**Gives back:** How many PolyPop plugins got the alert.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("polypop.triggerAlert", new { alertName = "Follow", variables = new { user = "CoolViewer" } });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.polypop_trigger_alert(alert_name="Follow", variables={"user": "CoolViewer"})
    ```
